bio: Few places in Split offer such comfortable and pleasant accommodation, both in terms of the quality of the food and the setting. On the shoreline, just outside the centre, this restaurant is distinguished by its charming tree-lined garden overlooking the sea, where shaded tables provide a very pleasant respite.  The relaxed environment and attentive, welcoming family management contribute to a convivial and authentic atmosphere. The cuisine is Mediterranean, with a focus on the wood-fired grill, on which fish and shellfish are prepared. The catch of the day is displayed in a refrigerated counter at the entrance so guests can choose directly from the freshest offerings. The wine list is well curated, with an interesting selection and a professional advisory service in the dining room....
